answer: Arrival-Interval Bridge Quota. New agent identities must wait through a randomized gale of admission windows before their first outbound traffic is relayed; each identity buffers through a nebula of relay hops that sample and record inter-arrival gaps. An identity only earns relay priority once its gap distribution stays within the organic envelope. To spoof it, an attacker pays per-identity delay and idle relay capacity for every clone, making mass registration cost scale linearly with the fleet rather than a one-time fee.
